# Third-Party Dependencies

This directory contains vendored (checked-in) third-party dependencies.
None of the code in this directory was written for this project — it is
included here for build convenience only.

## nlohmann/json (v3.12.0)

- Source: https://github.com/nlohmann/json
- License: MIT
- Included as a single vendored header: `nlohmann/json.hpp`
